profile.name: Abdulrasaq Taofeeq Olarewaju
profile.headline: Backend-leaning fullstack engineer
profile.summary: Self-taught software engineer with 4+ years building and shipping production backend-leaning fullstack products. Leads a development team of 10+ at Tobams Group across Nexus, RLK, RLM and Rareeat, three repos and two domains on one shared API, and owns SafePick end-to-end at Pacifylabs, where I also build and test Rakuxon Care, SCIMS, EduMimi and KudiPay and mentor 20+ learners. Node.js, TypeScript and NestJS with PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Redis; React and Next.js frontends; authentication and RBAC; Stripe, PayPal and Paystack payments; AI integration. B.Sc. Chemistry, then self-taught. Author of The Server Side of Next.js, React to Engineer and Python Before AI.
profile.whatsappMessage: Hi Abdulrasaq, I saw your profile on Sheetfolio and would like to discuss a project.

experiences.notes: Leads a team of 10+ across a three-repo product spanning two domains on a shared API, shipping and reviewing Nexus, RLK, RLM and Rareeat. Joined as a contract backend developer: optimised MongoDB indexing, built a secure authentication system, integrated PayPal and Stripe payments, and built e-commerce checkout backend systems.

Owns SafePick end-to-end; builds and tests Rakuxon Care, SCIMS, EduMimi and KudiPay. Backend services and RESTful APIs in Node.js and TypeScript for Megamart and BookMyTime, with authentication, authorization and payment and email integrations. Mentors 20+ learners in JavaScript and backend and fullstack development, supervising projects and conducting code reviews.

Served the National Youth Service Corps year as a fullstack and web developer: tested a startup product before production, built mobile-responsive interfaces, and contributed to the frontend and backend of MedCare.
